paragraphs: Rabbi Yonatan of Beit Guvrin, in Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi’s name. Rabbi Simon said in his name: Jerusalem Talmud, Yoma, chapter 7, halakhah 5 (7:3:4 in the linked edition); Midrash Chazit, on ‘Song of songs’; Kohelet Rabbah, on ‘A time to give birth.’ ‘Rabbi Natan’ is a scribal error, for the same matter in Rabbah there, on ‘When goods increase,’ has Yonatan. Rabbi Yonatan transmitted in his name, there. In Rabbah, Metzora, section 17: Rabbi Yaakov said in Rabbi Yehudah’s name, in Rabbi Natan of Beit Guvrin’s name.
